system.enhancements: Access Jacks, Cyberclaws, Grip Pads, Pneumatic Limbs
system.biography:
Named for the way it scurries and jumps like a spider, this robotic hand is normally used by neo-avians, neooctopi, and neo-cetaceans who need a human hand design and/or some additional strength to handle certain tasks. It should be noted that the hand does not possess the leverage of a body behind it, so there are limitations to what it can do, though it can extend a meter-long brace for stabilization and support. They have an effective SOM of 10.

Source: Eclipse Phase Panopticon, p. 158.
